intended_object: The hom-sets of the discrete category on a type α: Hom(a, b) has exactly one element when a = b and is empty otherwise. Inferred from the docstring and from the name `Discrete.Hom`.
explanation: The structure has one field, a proof of `a = b`. It is therefore empty when a ≠ b, and has exactly one element when a = b because proofs of an equality are all equal (proof irrelevance). These are exactly the hom-sets of the discrete category, in which the only morphisms are identities. The type α is arbitrary, so the definition has its natural generality. Wrapping the equality in its own structure is only an implementation choice and does not change the meaning.
